title.zh: The fight over Ethereum’s supply is forcing a choice between high staking yields and the value of your ETH
title.en: The fight over Ethereum’s supply is forcing a choice between high staking yields and the value of your ETH

current_state.zh: The Ethereum Foundation's Protocol cluster has declined to prioritize EIP-8363, which would burn part of validator rewards, and instead calls for a broader ecosystem debate on issuance policy, highlighting a trade-off between staking yields and ETH value.
current_state.en: The Ethereum Foundation's Protocol cluster has declined to prioritize EIP-8363, which would burn part of validator rewards, and instead calls for a broader ecosystem debate on issuance policy, highlighting a trade-off between staking yields and ETH value.
